answer: Because the garden solution is checked at the yarrow gate and logged, the inlet audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 21 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. That is 15 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
